purge_logs.title: Log retention
purge_logs.desc: Purging strategy for old pipeline logs. A purge is attempted for each pipeline run if at least one option is set to a valid value. Multiple options are combined with 'AND'. Set to '-1' or empty to avoid purging.
purge_logs.duration: duration (e.g. '24h'). Only minutes (m) and hours (h) are allowed. Leave empty to ignore.
purge_logs.keep_min: pipelines (min. # of pipelines). Set to '-1' to ignore.
